title: Home
description: Six coffees, six JSON files, six pages.
heading: Six coffees on the list this month
lede: Every coffee we sell is one JSON file in a folder. Adding the seventh means writing the seventh file — no new page, no new route, no change to the build script.

highlights.name: One file per coffee
highlights.note: models/roasts holds six JSON files. Naming the folder as the model hands the whole array to .pages().

highlights.name: One view for all six
highlights.note: roasts/roast.hbs is rendered once per entry, and the controller gives each one a slug of its own.

highlights.name: One index, same data
highlights.note: The listing page is built from the array the fan-out already resolved, so it cannot fall out of step.
